newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Hansapank dips after results.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Hansapank dips after results.

text.p: Shares in market leader Hansapank dipped after it announced its 1996 profits and what some saw as a disappointing forecast for 1997, dealers said.
Dealers said Hansapank was quoted at 180/181 kroons versus Wednesday's 183.80 kroons close but fell as low as 175 kroons.
Hansapank said its non-consolidated profit in 1996 was 234.4 million kroons versus 149.7 million kroons and forecast a 1997 group profit of 320 million kroons.
"It was a great disappointment, the forecast was too low," said one trader although he noted there was not huge pressure on the price.
He said that the market had been hoping for forecast 1997 earnings of around 360 million kroons to 370 million kroons.
Other traders said the dip in Hansapank's shares was due to the general decline in Estonian shares, undergoing a slight correction after rallying since the start of the year.
